state.status_forbidden: No permission to view the queue

plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings, so they are shown as read-only.

settings.title: CloudFront CDN Settings
settings.description: Set the CloudFront distribution URL and invalidation credentials, and check that invalidations are not backed up.
settings.notice: Files are stored where the S3 settings (bucket, region, credentials) on Settings > Drivers point, and are served through the CDN URL below. After enabling this plugin, open Storage & Cache on Settings > Upload and choose CloudFront as the Storage Disk of Public image thumbnails.

cdn_base_url.label: CDN base URL
cdn_base_url.hint: Domain URL of the CloudFront distribution (e.g. https://cdn.example.com). When empty, files are stored on S3 but served through the server.

distribution_id.label: Distribution ID
distribution_id.hint: ID of the CloudFront distribution to invalidate.

access_key.label: Invalidation access key
access_key.hint: A separate IAM key that only has CloudFront invalidation permission. The S3 key is never used instead; leave empty to skip cache invalidation.

secret_key.label: Invalidation secret key
secret_key.hint: Secret key of the access key above. The saved value is masked; enter a new one only when changing it.

purge_enabled.label: Automatic cache invalidation
purge_enabled.hint: Sends a CDN cache invalidation when thumbnails are removed. Requires the distribution ID and invalidation keys.

connection.title: Connection test
connection.hint: Looks up the distribution with the saved distribution ID and invalidation keys. Save your changes first.
connection.disabled: This distribution is disabled in CloudFront. Files are not served from the CDN URL until it is enabled.
connection.host_mismatch: The CDN URL domain is neither this distribution's domain nor one of its alternate domains. Invalidations may not clear the cache of the URLs shown on the site.

purge_status.title: Invalidation queue
purge_status.hint: Failed invalidations are resent after 5 minutes, doubling the wait each time, and stop after 5 failures. Stopped entries are removed after 30 days.
purge_status.not_ready: Invalidations are not sent right now because the distribution ID, invalidation keys or CDN URL is empty, or automatic invalidation is off.
purge_status.forbidden: You do not have permission to view the invalidation queue.
